item.title: Democrat flips Florida state legislative district that includes Mar-a-Lago
item.description: Democrat Emily Gregory won a special election for a Florida state House seat on Tuesday, flipping a district that is home to President Trump's estate, Mar-a-Lago.

item.title: 3/24: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Trump says Vance and Rubio are involved in talks with Iran; Senate inches toward a potential DHS funding solution.

item.title: Wife of Hawaii doctor takes stand one year after he allegedly tried to kill her
item.description: Arielle Konig took the stand to testify against her husband, anesthesiologist Gerhardt Konig, exactly one year after he allegedly tried to kill her by pushing her off a cliff during a hike.

item.title: 2 pilots killed in LaGuardia Airport runway collision identified
item.description: The pilots killed in a collision between a jetliner and a fire truck on a New York runway have been identified as Capt. Antoine Forrest and First Officer Mackenzie Gunther.

item.title: We asked every lawmaker in Congress what they’re doing to end the DHS shutdown
item.description: Lawmakers and President Trump appear to be edging closer to a framework to wrap up the Department of Homeland Security shutdown — but a breakthrough has remained out of reach. CBS News contacted every House and Senate office to ask what they're doing t...

item.title: DOJ found no evidence of a crime in Fed renovation project, prosecutor admits
item.description: The Justice Department's investigation of a $2.5 billion renovation project at the Federal Reserve found no evidence of a crime, a federal prosecutor privately conceded under questioning by a judge.
